title: Narrative Contexts
description: Contextual frames that alter narrative meaning.

entries.title: Narration
entries.description: Narrated story text rather than speech.

entries.title: Historical Narration
entries.description: Narration that reports a past event as history.

entries.title: Flashback
entries.description: A recollection of an earlier time.

entries.title: Flashforward
entries.description: A preview of a later event.

entries.title: Voice Over
entries.description: Narration layered on top of the scene.

entries.title: Unreliable Narrator
entries.description: A narrator whose account may be incomplete or false.

entries.title: Cross Scene Memory
entries.description: Meaning inherited from an earlier or later scene.

entries.title: Story Endorsement
entries.description: The story appears to endorse an idea.

entries.title: Author Endorsement
entries.description: A story-level cue that the author endorses something.

entries.title: Viewer Interpretation
entries.description: How a reviewer or viewer reads the scene.
